summary: Narrow backend verification of the Complete Board Fix member-mode intake bug fix. Created a fresh dedicated member (bufintake-tester-<ts>@example.com / BufTest123!) via POST /api/members/register and granted board_fix_system directly in Mongo. 13/13 pytest tests passed: (1) POST /api/board-fix-intake/submit with session_id:'' now returns 200 (NO 422) with redirect_url '/board-fix-orientation' on first submission and succeeds with no bylaws uploaded; (2) GET /api/board-fix-intake/context (no session_id, cookie auth) returns eligible:true, submitted:true, saved answers, lead_name and bylaws_filename; (3) edited re-submit returns 200 with redirect_url '/board-fix-roadmap' and Mongo holds exactly ONE board_fix_intakes doc (session_id member-intake-<user_id>, no duplicates); Bearer-token submit also works; (4) bylaws upload: PDF multipart with session_id='' -> 201 {status:uploaded, filename}, context + Mongo show bylaws_filename/bylaws_uploaded_at and data.bylaws_text with extracted text, .txt -> 400, no auth -> 401, bogus session_id -> 403; (5) security gates: submit no auth -> 401, module-tester@example.com (no entitlement) -> 403, bogus stripe session cs_test_bogus123 -> 403; (6) regression: GET context?session_id=cs_test_bogus123 -> 200 {eligible:false} (not 500). No AI calls, no emails, no Stripe checkouts. rooney@nonprofitboardbuilder.com records untouched. All test-created member/intake/journey/profile docs deleted in teardown.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor (non-blocking): upload_board_fix_bylaws in member mode does two lookups on board_fix_intakes (existing by user_id, then intake by session_id) — the second check is redundant and could be collapsed.
Minor: bylaws text is truncated to 120000 chars at write time but extract_cv_text already caps at 20000, so the 120k slice is dead code.
seed_data_creation: One throwaway member per run (bufintake-tester-<timestamp>-<worker>@example.com / BufTest123!) with entitlement board_fix_system granted in Mongo; fully deleted in session teardown (members, board_fix_intakes, board_fix_journeys, recruitment_profiles). No residual data — verified via Mongo query after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter60_board_fix_intake_member.py is self-contained and re-runnable (registers a unique member each run, per-xdist-worker email, cleans up after itself). It does NOT touch rooney's data. Frontend BoardFixIntakePage.jsx was intentionally not tested per request.
rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: IntakeSubmit.session_id had Field(min_length=1) so the frontend's session_id:'' was rejected by pydantic with 422 before the member-auth branch could run, surfacing as 'We could not save your intake'. Fix (session_id: str = '') verified working; the new logger.exception wrapper produced no entries during testing, confirming no residual 500 path.
